Scan for QTL

Source: R/fct_qtl.R
scan_qtl.Rd

Interval mapping (qtl::scanone()) or composite interval mapping (qtl::cim()) for one trait, with a genome-wide LOD threshold from permutations (Churchill and Doerge 1994). For each linkage group whose highest LOD passes the threshold, the peak is reported with its 1.5-LOD support interval, nearest marker, genome-wide p-value, percentage of phenotypic variance explained and estimated effects.

Usage

scan_qtl(
  cross,
  trait = NULL,
  method = "hk",
  cim = FALSE,
  n_marcovar = 3,
  window = 10,
  n_perm = 1000,
  alpha = 0.05,
  step = 1,
  seed = 1,
  progress = NULL
)

Arguments

cross

A cross from build_cross().

trait

Trait name.

method

One of qtl_methods().

cim

Use composite interval mapping.

n_marcovar, window

Marker covariates and window (cM) for CIM.

n_perm

Number of permutations.

alpha

Genome-wide significance level.

step

Spacing (cM) of the scan.

seed

Random seed.

progress

Optional function called with the share done (0 to 1).

Value

An lm_qtl list.
